note: Lag-aware turns after a checkpoint switch for the fast race-cue pilot (FastRaceCue lag_turn=LagTurnConfig). Off unless the runner is given --lag-turn; then the entry for the active motor contract applies (null = off for that contract, and the runner refuses --lag-turn for it). Lead, clip, heading time constant and window are the a-priori M2 plan values (course_lead 0.6 clipped to 15 deg, heading time constant 0.10 s, first second after a switch), not fitted to any course; trigger_deg/trigger_span_s follow the anatomy study's switch detector (bearing jump within two frames). The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a changed file needs a new version and a new freeze, and every frozen version used for scoring is reported.
rule: trigger: a fresh in-view (not edge-clamped) cue whose azimuth differs by >= trigger_deg from the filtered bearing or from an in-view cue captured within trigger_span_s; for window_s after it, while the ring is in view (pilot state cue): aim course_lead*(bearing - flown course) beyond the bearing, clipped to course_lead_max_deg (no lead below min_course_speed or beyond max_lead_angle_deg), and taper the request heading with heading_time_constant instead of command_time_constant; both fade out over the last fade_s; turn_acceleration still bounds the heading rate and the speed schedule is unchanged

response_models.note: Declared motor response to a horizontal velocity request (documentation of why a lead is needed and the kinematic models used for offline replays; the pilot does not read these). Delay plus first-order lag fitted on fast-stack-20260923 logs: brain-08 0.14-0.16 s plus 0.20-0.58 s (0.32-0.39 s overall on Straw Bale), fast PD 0.08-0.10 s plus about 0.04 s (0.11-0.14 s overall).
